verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no Twilio data-retention policies, retention periods, or deletion APIs for messages, recordings, or other customer data. The closest item is an API for default call-recording settings (twilio-docs-1). That controls whether calls are recorded, not how long data is kept or how it is deleted, so it is an adjacent control and earns no credit. The community complaint about Authy data export concerns export, not retention or deletion, and does not bear on this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
